# CMake consumer for the rules_bdeg smoke test.
#
# Consumes the CMake packages generated by //:export_all and links a real
# executable against Bazel-built libraries, proving find_package + headers +
# defines + transitive-closure linking all work end to end.
#
# Usage (normally driven by ../run_tests.sh):
#   cmake -S consumer -B consumer/build -DBDEG_DIR=/path/to/cmake-packages
#   cmake --build consumer/build
#   ctest --test-dir consumer/build --output-on-failure

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)

project(bdeg_smoke_consumer
    VERSION 1.0.0
    LANGUAGES CXX
    DESCRIPTION "End-to-end consumer for the rules_bdeg smoke test"
)

if(NOT DEFINED BDEG_DIR)
    set(BDEG_DIR "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake-packages")
endif()

if(NOT EXISTS "${BDEG_DIR}/bdeg-deps.cmake")
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "BDEG packages not found at ${BDEG_DIR}\n"
        "Build the export first:  bazel build //:export_all")
endif()

# Umbrella: sets BDEG_EXECROOT + BDEG_OUTPUT_BASE and includes every package.
include("${BDEG_DIR}/bdeg-deps.cmake")
if(EXISTS "${BDEG_DIR}/bdeg-toolchain.cmake")
    include("${BDEG_DIR}/bdeg-toolchain.cmake")
endif()

# Validate each generated Config independently.
find_package(GTest REQUIRED)
find_package(GTestMain REQUIRED)
find_package(Calc REQUIRED)
find_package(AddLib REQUIRED)

add_executable(smoke_test main.cpp)

# Deliberately link only Calc::Calc (not AddLib). AddLib::add is pulled in
# transitively via Calc's INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES, exercising cross-package
# reference resolution.
target_link_libraries(smoke_test
    PRIVATE
        GTestMain::gtest_main
        GTest::gtest
        Calc::Calc
)

enable_testing()
include(GoogleTest)
gtest_discover_tests(smoke_test)
